propositions: Plan review dominates LLM spend with high re-run rates and many calls per review.
An evidence-backed program of changes reduces token spend without weakening gate outcomes.
Pass-1 usage instrumentation must land so coverage metrics report input/output/cache token counts.
Cache optimizations and pre-LLM short-circuits reduce redundant LLM calls.
Blocking criteria use operator-approved thresholds and all previously blocking criteria remain blocking.
Changes touching pass1.py/passes.py and criteria_routing.json are serialized to avoid textual conflicts.
